name: context-guard
description: Preserve task requirements and verify evidence, scope, surfaces, and multimodal assets across compaction.

interface.shortDescription: Preserve long-task context across Codex compaction.
interface.longDescription: Journals authoritative task requirements locally, records hash-only multimodal assets, enforces deterministic verification contracts when available, falls back audibly when unavailable, restores bounded context after compaction, and exports explicit successor packs.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $context-guard to protect this long-running task from context loss.
